text: Tour of Duty: Stormsong Valley is a PvP achievement earned for earning 1,000 honor from honorable kills in Stormsong Valley while War Mode is enabled.
Tour of Duty: Nazmir is a PvP achievement earned for earning 1,000 honor from honorable kills in Nazmir while War Mode is enabled.
Tour of Duty: Drustvar is a PvP achievement earned for earning 1,000 honor from honorable kills in Drustvar while War Mode is enabled.
The Totems of Gonk are totems, providing shortcuts, located all over Dazar'alor. They are only available to Horde adventurers who have pledged themselves to Gonk in Gonk, Lord of the Pack.
__NOTOC__ Totem Maker Jash'ga is a blood dire troll located in a hut in Natha'vor in Nazmir.
Totem Matriarch's Headdress drops from Totem Maker Jash'ga in Nazmir.
The Totem of Seafaring would be an objective of Shadow Hunter Urko'jin (quest).

The Totem of Hir'eek is a bat statue located in the Ruins of Jubuwal in the Cape of Stranglethorn. During Backdoor Dealings, players place the Gurubashi Incense at the totem to receive Hir'eek's guidance.

Tour of Duty: Nazjatar is a player vs. player achievement earned by earning 1000 honor in Nazjatar while in War Mode.
Tour of the Depths is an exploration achievement earned by completing a series of Nazjatar objectives.
Tour of War is an expansion feature achievement earned by defeating the enemy commanders in the Battle for Stromgarde.
Totemic Surge is a conduit for shaman. It drops from So'leah in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market, Shriekwing in Castle Nathria, and the Lords of Dread in the Sepulcher of the First Ones.
Touch of the Everlasting is an Azerite Essence obtained through the Black Empire Campaign and the Uldum Accord reputation faction. This essence can only be used by tank specializations.
The Totem of Stolen Mojo is a quest reward from De Other Side: Dealin' Wit' Da Boss.

Touring Torghast is the first in a series of three achievements awarded for completing all wings of Torghast, Tower of the Damned. For this achievement, players must kill the layer bosses of each of the six wings in layer 1. Two wings are available each week, so this achievement will require a minimum of three weekly resets to complete.

The Tournament Announcer is a human businessman located in Dalaran. He is in charge of the Dalaran Pet Tournament, a series of world quests. He constantly alternates between celebrating alongside, berating, and firing his employee, Greg.

Tracking is a feature of the interface that enables players to track services, resource nodes, and creatures on the minimap. The "binoculars" icon on the left side of the minimap's header allows the player to choose which types of tracking are enabled. Some forms of tracking are restricted to certain classes and professions.
Trading is the way players exchange items, money and some services.

An item that can be processed by a Trade Skill to be used in a recipe for useful items. Example trade goods: * Leather, most can be processed into better leathers. * Cloth, can be processed into Bolts. * Ore, can be processed into Bars. * Dust, Essence & Shards, can be used for enchanting. * Elemental ingredients

Trade princes, also known as merchant princes and trade lords, are the main leaders of the goblin race. The title of trade prince is not necessarily equivalent to the leader of a goblin cartel. Although the Venture Company has been called a cartel, its president Razdunk is not a trade prince.
The is a one-handed dagger that occasionally releases a cloud of poison that damages all enemies nearby.

The Tower of Eldara was once part of the extensive night elven civilization that stretched across most of what is now called Azshara. It is located on the very tip of land northeast of the Bay of Storms, and the sandy beaches near the tower are heavily patrolled by murlocs, makrura, and hydras. The tower itself stands closed and abandoned. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, Phloem tried to open it, but without a success.

Traces of Silithyst is a buff acquired after turning in Silithyst dust at the player's respective collection site in Silithus. It is received alongside 20 reputation points with the Cenarion Circle faction and 19 honor points. The debuff has no effect for characters at level 70 or up.

The Tower of the Damned is located in the very center of Deatholme and serves as the headquarters of Dar'Khan Drathir, master of the Scourge in Quel'Thalas. The Tower's every entrance is guarded by the dreaded Eyes of Dar'Khan, and its halls inhabited by Deatholme Necromancers and their skeletal minions. Deep in the center is Dar'Khan himself.
__NOTOC__ Trackmaster Zherin is a tauren quest giver originally located at the Mirage Raceway in Thousand Needles. After the Raceway was flooded in the Cataclysm, he relocated to Splithoof Heights.
Tracker's Belt is a mail belt sought after by hunters and shamans.
Trade Master Kovic is a named gnome found in the westernmost cave of the Cauldron in Searing Gorge alongside his minion, Clunk. Nilith Lokrav wants Kovic's satchel.

A tower is a tall structure, taller than it is wide, often by a significant margin. Considering the origin of the Warcraft series as real time strategy games, the term most often refers to a defensive structure. Using towers offensively against an opponent is known as Offensive Towering.
__NOTOC__ Towering Mantle of the Hunt are typical hunter or enhancement shaman shoulders.

Tower Point is a watch tower for the Horde side in Alterac Valley. Numerous NPC patrols can be found around the tower, usually consisting of several guards and wolves. It is usually the second tower to be assaulted by Alliance players. It is found just south of Iceblood Graveyard. Like all towers and bunkers, it houses 4 Frostwolf Bowmen.
__NOTOC__ Tracker Lyceon is a draenei quest giver located at Blood Watch on Bloodmyst Isle.

Town Square is the eastern part of Kirin'Var Village. Numerous ghosts roam the area. There are four quests available: three from nearby quest givers and one from a quest chain that begins at Area 52. A ruined town hall is present.
